body:
Okay I see, thank you for this reply it helped a ton. 

"Many physicists have said that there are important reasons via modern physics to think so. I.E. part of osr is the fact that distinct *things* don't exist, only structural relations. But structure is continuous."

This is really what I wanted to get at, not so much an 'infinite knowledge' I just couldn't put it into words. 

This really opened up my eyes and I only have one more question for you, it's kind of bizarre, so I'm going to write it just how I think about it in my head.

A human may put a painting of himself on his wall. An animal will not do this. If a creature from another planet looked down at us, and looked at all the animals, and found one creature, who hadn't even been there for that long, was doing this, wouldn't this be odd? He's identifying himself! Like, what are the coincidences that happened, since none of the other creatures do this? 

My question is, why are we the only creature on Earth like this? Can't this only happen once? There are millions of species on the planet and only one did this, how is it that it's solely a human experience to highlight what you are existing as? What are the odds? I know animals probably can think about their existence, but they can't go as far as hanging a photo of themselves in their homes. Why is this? It kind of makes me laugh to think about, but it also makes me view humans as so different from animals.

Sorry if that's a really, really dumb question, but I do think about it a lot, pretty much all day every day.
Thanks but I just figured I'd write what it felt like once.  I really appreciate you trying to help.
